nodes.label: Hierarchical Auto-Merging Retrieval Strategy
nodes.rationale: Child nodes are stored as vectors in Qdrant for precise similarity search. When enough sibling children are retrieved (>=AUTOMERGE_THRESHOLD fraction), they are promoted to the parent node from docstore.json. This solves the 'needle in the haystack' problem: precise search via small chunks, richer context via larger parent nodes sent to the LLM.

nodes.label: Incremental Indexing via SHA-256 Manifest
nodes.rationale: Each document's SHA-256 hash is stored in index-manifest.json. On re-run, only new/changed documents are re-embedded; unchanged ones are skipped entirely. Deleted documents are cleaned from Qdrant and docstore. This avoids redundant embedding API calls on large corpora.

nodes.label: qwen3-embedding Model Selection Rationale
nodes.rationale: qwen3-embedding:latest chosen for: multilingual quality (strong on Dutch), 4096-dimensional vectors for expressive similarity distinctions, and top MTEB multilingual leaderboard performance.
